intro: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides is a task to assist an injured hunter or tradesperson who needs raw lion pelts to satisfy a trade agreement with a local tanner. Unable to hunt safely due to their wounds, they rely on traveling adventurers to deliver the materials and preserve their pristine professional record.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, these look like they will do nicely. I have an arrangement with a local tanner to deliver these raw hides in exchange for various finished leather goods that I use as part of my trade.
I've never come up short on my end of the arrangement, and even with my injury I do not intend to start now.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
